# Changelog
Source: https://docs.meshy.ai/api/changelog

# Changelog

See all of the latest features and updates to the Meshy API and plugins.

Prefer a live feed? The latest entries also show up on the [Developer Platform](https://www.meshy.ai/developers) overview page.

---

## October 2026
### `Oct 30`

- Meshy T1 (`model_type: "lowpoly"` and `ai_model: "meshy-t1"`) has been retired on [Text to 3D](/api/text-to-3d#create-a-text-to-3d-preview-task) and [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d#create-an-image-to-3d-task), and `model_type: "smart-topology"` with `ai_model: "meshy-t2.5"` replaces it.
- The [Auto Split API](/api/auto-split) has a new optional parameter, `keep_texture`. With `keep_texture: true`, every part of a textured model keeps the texture, and the task returns the texture maps in `texture_urls`, plus an `mtl` file with an OBJ. Without it, a split works as before. A split that keeps the texture takes about twice as long and still costs 10 credits. `input_task_id` also accepts Text to 3D refine and Retexture tasks.

### `Oct 26`

- New [Deprecations](/api/deprecations) page: the lifecycle of every 3D generation model (active, legacy, deprecated, or retired) with its retirement date and recommended replacement, the history of every API deprecation, and the deprecated parameters still in service. The retirement banner on API pages now links to it.

### `Oct 23`

- Deprecated `texture_image_url` on [Rigging](/api/rigging#create-a-rigging-task). Meshy uses the textures embedded in the `model_url` file, or the input task's textures, so leave it out when the model has its own textures. If you send it, the image becomes the rigged model's only texture, and the model loses its PBR maps.

### `Oct 21`

- Added the `X-Meshy-Metadata` header for Studio and Enterprise teams to every endpoint that creates a task, except Creative Lab endpoints. Tag a task with your own key-value pairs, such as `user=alex@example.com,team=fab`, and read them back in the `metadata` field of [Usage](/api/usage#the-usage-record-object) records. See [Metadata](/api/metadata).

### `Oct 19`

- `export_resolution` now accepts values up to `512`, down from `2048`, on [Keychain](/api/creative-lab-keychain#create-a-keychain-build-task) and [Fridge Magnet](/api/creative-lab-fridge-magnet#create-a-fridge-magnet-build-task) build tasks. `512` is the resolution of the depth map the geometry is built from, so every value above it placed extra vertices between samples that already existed, giving a larger file that describes the same surface. `512` is also the default, so callers that never set `export_resolution` are unaffected. A value above `512` now returns `400` at create time instead of being accepted. `2048` in particular always ran past the generator's deadline and failed after the task had started. If you set `export_resolution` above `512`, drop the parameter or set it to `512`.
### `Oct 15`

- Added `ai_model: "meshy-t2.5"` to the [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d#create-an-image-to-3d-task) and [Text to 3D](/api/text-to-3d#create-a-text-to-3d-preview-task) APIs: the newest Smart Topology model, with sharper detail for game assets. Use it with `model_type: "smart-topology"`; output is triangle-only, and `target_polycount` accepts 100 to 30,000 (default 15,000). Pricing is the same as `meshy-t2`; see [Pricing](/api/pricing). It is now the default when `model_type: "smart-topology"` is set without `ai_model`; set `ai_model: "meshy-t2"` to keep using Meshy T2. Multi-Image to 3D does not support `meshy-t2.5`.

### `Oct 14`

- `model_url` now accepts files up to 400 MB, up from 100 MB, when it is an `http` or `https` URL, on [Retexture](/api/retexture#create-a-retexture-task), [Remesh](/api/remesh#create-a-remesh-task), [Rigging](/api/rigging#create-a-rigging-task), [Convert](/api/convert#create-a-convert-task), [Resize](/api/resize#create-a-resize-task), [UV Unwrap](/api/uv-unwrap#create-an-uv-unwrap-task), [Multi-Color Print](/api/multi-color-print#create-a-multi-color-3d-print-task), [Analyze Printability](/api/analyze-printability#create-an-analyze-printability-task), and [Repair Printability](/api/repair-printability#create-a-repair-printability-task). A `data:` URI stays at 100 MB. A GLB, glTF, FBX, or OBJ file over 100 MB can have at most 10,000,000 faces (8,000,000 for Multi-Color Print), counted as triangles; a file with more returns `400`. Over 100 MB, an FBX file must be binary FBX 7.1 or newer, and a GLB or glTF file must not use Draco compression. The file is downloaded before the create request returns, so allow up to 120 seconds for a large one (see [Task Lifecycle](/api/task-lifecycle#how-long-to-wait)). Files of 100 MB or less behave as before, and pricing is unchanged.
- [Analyze Printability](/api/analyze-printability#create-an-analyze-printability-task) now answers an `input_task_id` that belongs to another account with `404` and the same body as an id that doesn't exist, instead of `403`. A task of yours, or of a teammate in a workspace you belong to, works as before.

### `Oct 12`

- USDZ files now use metres, so models open at their real size in AR Quick Look, Reality Composer, Blender, and other USD viewers. The `usdz` file in `model_urls` of [Text to 3D](/api/text-to-3d), [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d), [Multi-Image to 3D](/api/multi-image-to-3d), [Retexture](/api/retexture), [Remesh](/api/remesh), [Convert](/api/convert), [Resize](/api/resize), and [Auto Split](/api/auto-split) tasks now declares `metersPerUnit = 1`. Until now it declared feet (`metersPerUnit = 0.3048`) while its coordinates were in metres, so the model showed at 30.48% of its size. If you scale USDZ files by 3.28 to compensate, remove that scaling for tasks created from this date on. Files of earlier tasks keep their current unit, and [Rigging](/api/rigging) and [Animation](/api/animation) USDZ files are not affected.

### `Oct 10`

- `meshy-5` has been retired. Requests that send `ai_model: "meshy-5"` to [Text to 3D](/api/text-to-3d#create-a-text-to-3d-preview-task), [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d#create-an-image-to-3d-task), [Multi-Image to 3D](/api/multi-image-to-3d#create-a-multi-image-to-3d-task), or [Retexture](/api/retexture#create-a-retexture-task) now return `400` with the message `ai_model meshy-5 has been retired; use meshy-6-lite`. Switch to `meshy-6-lite`, which takes the same parameters at the same credit cost. Models you already generated with `meshy-5` stay available, and refining a `meshy-5` preview without setting `ai_model` still works.
- `.webp` is now documented as a supported image input format, alongside `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, and `.png`, on [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d#create-an-image-to-3d-task), [Multi-Image to 3D](/api/multi-image-to-3d#create-a-multi-image-to-3d-task), [Image to Image](/api/image-to-image#create-an-image-to-image-task), [Retexture](/api/retexture#create-a-retexture-task) (`image_style_url`), and [Text to 3D Refine](/api/text-to-3d#create-a-text-to-3d-refine-task) (`texture_image_url`). It works for both public URLs and data URIs (`data:image/webp;base64,...`). Existing integrations are unaffected, and pricing is unchanged.
- [Get Balance](/api/balance#get-balance) now also returns `monthly_credits`, `permanent_credits`, and `monthly_resets_at`, so you can see how much of your balance expires at the next refresh. `balance` itself is unchanged.

### `Oct 6`

- [Analyze Printability](/api/analyze-printability#create-an-analyze-printability-task) and [Repair Printability](/api/repair-printability#create-a-repair-printability-task) can now check wall thickness at the size you plan to print. Send `printer_type`, a print size, or both. Analyze reports thin walls in `printability.thin_walls`, and repair thickens them when needed, and can reuse the printer and size of an analyze task passed as `input_task_id`. Integrations that don't use these fields behave as before, and pricing is unchanged.

## September 2026
### `Sep 29`

- The legacy `/v2/text-to-3d` path (without the `/openapi` prefix) is deprecated. It keeps working unchanged for now, but will be removed in a future release. Switch to [`/openapi/v2/text-to-3d`](/api/text-to-3d), which takes the same request and returns the same response. Responses on the legacy path now carry a `Deprecation` header and a `Link` header pointing to the new path.

### `Sep 28`

- API responses now include [rate limit headers](/api/rate-limits#rate-limit-headers), including `Retry-After` to tell you how long to wait before retrying or polling again.
- [Multi-Color Print](/api/multi-color-print) accepts a new `printer_brand` parameter that writes a matching slicer preset into the 3MF, so the file opens ready to print on Anycubic, Creality, Elegoo, Flashforge, Prusa, Qidi, Snapmaker, and AnkerMake printers as well as Bambu Lab (the default). The page now also documents `max_depth`.

### `Sep 18`

- Added `meshy-7.1` as an `ai_model` value for [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d#create-an-image-to-3d-task),
  [Multi-Image to 3D](/api/multi-image-to-3d#create-a-multi-image-to-3d-task), and
  [Text to 3D](/api/text-to-3d#create-a-text-to-3d-preview-task): same parameters and credit cost as
  `meshy-7`, higher geometry detail. `latest` now resolves to `meshy-7.1`; `meshy-7` is deprecated but keeps working unchanged.
- Added `geometry_resolution` (`standard` / `2k` / `4k`) to the same APIs, replacing the now-deprecated
  `ultra_mode` (`ultra_mode: true` still works and equals `"2k"`). `4k` requires Meshy 7.1 (`meshy-7.1` or `latest`), is not
  available on Multi-Image to 3D, and costs the same 5 extra credits as `2k`.

### `Sep 16`

- The [Auto Split API](/api/auto-split) now accepts a textured `input_task_id`. It previously rejected one with `400`, which meant generating the same mesh a second time with `should_texture: false` to split it. A split cuts geometry and rebuilds each part's surfaces, so the input's texture is not carried over and the result is an untextured model with one flat color per part. That was already true of every split and is unchanged.
- `meshy-5` will be retired on **October 10, 2026**. It is no longer documented as an `ai_model` value for [Text to 3D](/api/text-to-3d#create-a-text-to-3d-preview-task), [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d#create-an-image-to-3d-task), [Multi-Image to 3D](/api/multi-image-to-3d#create-a-multi-image-to-3d-task), or [Retexture](/api/retexture#create-a-retexture-task), and after October 10 requests that send `ai_model: "meshy-5"` will return an error.
- The shared **test-mode API key** has been retired; requests that still send it now return `401 Unauthorized`. If you copied it into code or CI, replace it with your own key from the [API Keys page](https://www.meshy.ai/developers/keys). That key always returned the same sample model regardless of input, so it never showed what a request would actually generate. To see what the API returns before building against it, use the [Playground](/api/developer-platform#playground) in the Developer Platform, which runs a real task in your browser. On plans without API access it runs Image to 3D without an API key and uses your account's credits like any other task.

### `Sep 15`

- Added `gpt-image-2-5-flare` and `gpt-image-2-5-sunburst` to the documented `ai_model` values for the [Text to Image](/api/text-to-image#create-a-text-to-image-task) and [Image to Image](/api/image-to-image#create-an-image-to-image-task) APIs. These are OpenAI GPT Image 2.5 tiers, priced the same as `gpt-image-2` (Text to Image: 9 credits; Image to Image: 12 credits).
- The GPT Image models (`gpt-image-2`, `gpt-image-2-5-flare`, `gpt-image-2-5-sunburst`) now also accept the `4:3` and `3:4` aspect ratios on the [Text to Image](/api/text-to-image#create-a-text-to-image-task) and [Image to Image](/api/image-to-image#create-an-image-to-image-task) APIs, in addition to `1:1`, `16:9`, `9:16`, `3:2`, and `2:3`.

### `Sep 14`

- The [Image to Image API](/api/image-to-image#create-an-image-to-image-task) now accepts `input_task_id`, so you can chain directly from a completed Text to Image or Image to Image task instead of copying its output URLs into `reference_image_urls`.

### `Sep 11`

- Behavior change: `DELETE` on a task that is already `IN_PROGRESS` is now rejected with `409 Conflict`, and the task is left running. It previously returned `200 OK`, stopped the worker, and discarded the result, but kept the credits because only `PENDING` tasks are refundable. The call cost you both the model and the credits with nothing in the response to say so. If your integration deletes tasks in order to cancel them, note that a task the worker has already started cannot be cancelled. Wait for `SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED`, or `CANCELED`, then delete it. `PENDING` tasks are still deleted and refunded exactly as before, and terminal tasks are still deleted. Applies to every task family under `/openapi`. See [Errors](/api/errors).
- Added `meshy-6-lite` to the documented `ai_model` values for the [Text to 3D](/api/text-to-3d#create-a-text-to-3d-preview-task), [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d#create-an-image-to-3d-task), [Multi-Image to 3D](/api/multi-image-to-3d#create-a-multi-image-to-3d-task), and [Retexture](/api/retexture#create-a-retexture-task) APIs. It is the successor to `meshy-5`: same parameters, same credit cost (5 for the mesh, 15 with texture, 10 for a retexture).
- `meshy-5` is now deprecated across every API that accepts it. It keeps working and nothing about your request or your bill changes, but it will stop accepting new traffic in a future release. If your integration sends `ai_model: "meshy-5"`, migrate to `meshy-6-lite`.

### `Sep 9`

- New [Auto Split API](/api/auto-split): Split an untextured Meshy 6 or Meshy 7 model into separately printable parts. It splits automatically, by the parts you name (`by_parts`), or by color region (`by_color`), with optional mortise-and-tenon connectors and thin-wall reinforcement. Exports every part as its own object in `glb`, `obj`, `fbx`, `usdz`, `blend`, or `3mf`, either assembled or laid out on the build plate (`layout`). 10 credits per task.

### `Sep 7`

- Added the `name_text` parameter to the [Creative Lab Keychain API](/api/creative-lab-keychain#create-a-keychain-prototype-task) prototype stage: engrave a name of up to 10 characters on the keychain, the same personalization the web app offers. The build stage inherits the engraving automatically, and the prototype task object now returns `name_text` so you can confirm the exact text before building. `name` remains a display-only task label and is not engraved.

### `Sep 5`

- Added the [Creative Lab Fidget Pixel API](/api/creative-lab-fidget-pixel): turn a photo into a multi-color 3D-printable pixel-art fidget board in two stages. `POST /prototype` (6 credits) pixelizes the photo into a pixel-art image. Pass `type` as `person` or `other` to pick the pixelization style. `POST /build` (30 credits) samples it onto a `16` or `32` grid and turns every pixel into an interlocking `square` or `hex` piece, delivered as a single color-tagged 3MF for multi-filament printing. Piece geometry is tunable with `piece_size_mm`, `color_count`, and `piece_height_mm`.

### `Sep 4`

- Added [`GET /openapi/v1/animations/library`](/api/animation#list-animations) to the [Animation Library](/api/animation-library): fetch every preset action the [Animation API](/api/animation#create-an-animation-task) accepts (`action_id`, name, category, and an animated GIF preview) with search and category filters, so you can build your own action picker instead of reading the reference table. Free; consumes no credits.
- Added the [Creative Lab Collapsible Fidget API](/api/creative-lab-fidget-collapsible): turn a photo into a print-in-place collapsible fidget toy, where the subject's silhouette becomes nested concentric rings that collapse flat and stretch out again, printed in one piece with no assembly. A single `POST` carries the image through to the finished model. There is no prototype/build stage pair and no geometry parameters to tune. Each task costs 6 credits and returns both a printable STL and a GLB for previewing.

### `Sep 3`

- The [Creative Lab Lamp API](/api/creative-lab-lamp) prototype stage now returns a 3D model. `POST /prototype` turns the concept image into a hollow lampshade GLB, and the prototype task object gains `model_urls.glb` and `thumbnail_url` alongside `image_urls`. The build stage runs only the lamp processor on that model and now produces an open-bottom lampshade with a base plate for the light-source fixture. Pricing moves with the work. Prototype is 30 credits and build 6 credits (previously 6 and 30). The prototype `text` parameter was removed, and `image_url` is required.

### `Sep 2`

- The [Animation API](/api/animation#create-an-animation-task) now accepts `action_ids`, so you can apply up to 10 preset actions to a rigged character in one request and receive a **single file containing one animation clip per action**, ready to drive from a state machine in a game engine. Clips keep the order you list them in and carry the animation's library name. Costs 3 credits per action, and `post_process` applies to the merged file. See the [Animation Library Reference](/api/animation-library) for available ids and the [pricing table](/api/pricing).

### `Sep 1`

- Added the `ultra_mode` parameter to the [Multi-Image to 3D API](/api/multi-image-to-3d#create-a-multi-image-to-3d-task): enables Ultra generation on `ai_model` `meshy-7` (or `latest`) for higher-fidelity geometry with finer surface detail, for 5 extra credits. It is the same Ultra pass the [Image to 3D API](/api/image-to-3d#create-an-image-to-3d-task) offers, now available with multi-view inputs.
- Removed `meshy-t1` from the documented `ai_model` values for the [Image to 3D API](/api/image-to-3d#create-an-image-to-3d-task)'s Smart Topology `model_type`. Smart Topology now only documents `meshy-t2`; new integrations should use it instead. Meshy T1 is planned for deprecation. If your integration currently sends `ai_model: "meshy-t1"`, migrate to `meshy-t2`.

## August 2026
### `Aug 28`

- Added the [Usage API](/api/usage#list-usage-records) for Studio and Enterprise teams: programmatically export historic API task usage (endpoint, status, timestamps, the API key that ran each task, and `consumed_credits`) with standard pagination and time-window, endpoint, and status filters, for cost tracking and finance systems.

### `Aug 26`

- The [Animation API](/api/animation#create-an-animation-task) now accepts `motion_task_id`, so you can apply a motion clip generated with the [Text to Motion API](/api/text-to-motion) onto your rigged biped character, as an alternative to a preset `action_id`. Same 3 credits per task.

### `Aug 24`

- Expanded `aspect_ratio` support for `gpt-image-2` on the [Text to Image](/api/text-to-image#create-a-text-to-image-task) and [Image to Image](/api/image-to-image#create-an-image-to-image-task) APIs to add `16:9` and `9:16`. `gpt-image-2` now accepts `1:1`, `16:9`, `9:16`, `3:2`, and `2:3`; `4:3` and `3:4` remain unsupported for this model.

### `Aug 21`

- Added the [Text to Motion API](/api/text-to-motion): generate a character motion clip from a natural-language description, no character model required. Choose `prime` mode (10 credits, FBX output) for the highest quality or `swift` mode (3 credits, BVH output) for fast, economical generation, with clip durations of 2 to 10 seconds.

### `Aug 20`

- Added the `style` parameter to the [Multi-Color Print API](/api/multi-color-print#create-a-multi-color-3d-print-task): choose `realistic` (default) for texture-accurate colors, or `cartoon` for flat, uniform color regions and a smaller 3MF.
- Added the `remove_background` parameter to every Creative Lab prototype endpoint: [Figure](/api/creative-lab-figure#create-a-figure-prototype-task), [Vinyl Figure](/api/creative-lab-vinyl-figure#create-a-vinyl-figure-prototype-task), [Brick Figure](/api/creative-lab-brick-figure#create-a-brick-figure-prototype-task), [Keycap](/api/creative-lab-keycap#create-a-keycap-prototype-task), [Keychain](/api/creative-lab-keychain#create-a-keychain-prototype-task), [Fridge Magnet](/api/creative-lab-fridge-magnet#create-a-fridge-magnet-prototype-task), and [Lamp](/api/creative-lab-lamp#create-a-lamp-prototype-task). Set `remove_background: true` to receive the prototype image as a transparent RGBA PNG with the background removed.

### `Aug 18`

- Added the `texture_image_urls` parameter to the [Multi-Image to 3D API](/api/multi-image-to-3d#create-a-multi-image-to-3d-task): provide 1 to 4 images of the same object to guide texturing, instead of the single `texture_image_url`. Requires `ai_model` `meshy-7` or `latest`, and is independent of `image_urls`. The two lists can contain different images and different numbers of images.

### `Aug 17`

- Added the `remove_background` parameter to the [Text to Image API](/api/text-to-image#create-a-text-to-image-task) and [Image to Image API](/api/image-to-image#create-an-image-to-image-task). Set `remove_background: true` to receive the generated image as a transparent RGBA PNG with the background removed.

### `Aug 13`

- Added `ai_model: "meshy-7"` to the [Text to 3D API](/api/text-to-3d#create-a-text-to-3d-preview-task): our newest 3D generation model, with higher-fidelity geometry than Meshy 6. It also introduces the `ultra_mode` parameter on the preview task, which enables Ultra generation for even finer surface detail for 5 extra credits. To texture with Meshy 7, pass `ai_model: "meshy-7"` on the refine task or omit `ai_model` entirely.
- Added the **Smart Topology** `model_type` to the [Text to 3D API](/api/text-to-3d#create-a-text-to-3d-preview-task). Set `model_type: "smart-topology"` to generate with `meshy-t2`: cleaner topology, natively separated parts, triangle output, and a face count you can set with `target_polycount` (100 to 15,000, default 4,000). A Smart Topology preview costs 5 credits instead of 20; see [Pricing](/api/pricing). The existing `model_type: "lowpoly"` is now deprecated but continues to serve traffic for backward compatibility.

### `Aug 12`

- Added `ai_model: "meshy-7"` to the [Image to 3D API](/api/image-to-3d#create-an-image-to-3d-task): our newest 3D generation model, with higher-fidelity geometry than Meshy 6. It also introduces the `ultra_mode` parameter, which enables Ultra generation for even finer surface detail.
- Added `ai_model: "meshy-7"` to the [Multi-Image to 3D API](/api/multi-image-to-3d#create-a-multi-image-to-3d-task): Meshy's multi-view generation model, which conditions on all of your input views together and drives texturing from them.
- Added `ai_model: "meshy-7"` to the [Retexture API](/api/retexture#create-a-retexture-task): our newest texturing model, with sharper surface detail and cleaner PBR materials than Meshy 6. It also introduces the `multiview_image_urls` parameter. Provide 1 to 4 ordered views of the same object to drive multi-view texturing.

### `Aug 4`
- Expanded `model_url` input support to `.glb`, `.gltf`, `.obj`, `.fbx`, `.stl` for the [Analyze Printability](/api/analyze-printability) and [Repair Printability](/api/repair-printability) endpoints (previously `.glb`, `.stl`, `.obj`). Repair returns the repaired asset in its input format.

## July 2026
### `Jul 27`

- New **[Creative Lab Brick Figure API](/api/creative-lab-brick-figure)**: turn a photo into a brick-style collectible 3D minifigure. It uses the same two-stage workflow as the [Figure API](/api/creative-lab-figure). `prototype` (6 credits) generates a styled concept image, and `build` (30 credits) turns it into a textured 3D model with GLB and OBJ + MTL outputs. See [Pricing](/api/pricing) for the full breakdown.

### `Jul 22`

- New **[Creative Lab Keycap API](/api/creative-lab-keycap)**: turn a photo into a full-color custom mechanical keyboard keycap. It uses a two-stage workflow. `prototype` (12 credits) generates a finished-keycap design render, then `build` (50 credits) turns the design you pick (with `candidate_id`) into a textured 3D keycap model with GLB and OBJ bundle outputs, exported at real-world millimeter scale. Currently supports the standard Cherry MX 1u base (`cherry-mx-1x1-r1`); more standard sizes are planned. See [Pricing](/api/pricing) for the full breakdown.
### `Jul 21`

- We now support **8K base color textures** through a new `texture_resolution` parameter (`2k` / `4k` / `8k`) on the [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d#create-an-image-to-3d-task), [Multi-Image to 3D](/api/multi-image-to-3d#create-a-multi-image-to-3d-task), [Text to 3D Refine](/api/text-to-3d#create-a-text-to-3d-refine-task), and [Retexture](/api/retexture#create-a-retexture-task) endpoints. At `8k`, PBR maps are generated at 4K and no emission map is produced. 8K texture generation costs 15 credits (`2k`/`4k` remain 10). See [Pricing](/api/pricing).
- The `hd_texture` boolean is deprecated in favor of `texture_resolution`. It is still honored and equivalent to `texture_resolution: "4k"` for backward compatibility.

### `Jul 20`

- New **[Creative Lab Vinyl Figure API](/api/creative-lab-vinyl-figure)**: turn a photo into a big-head vinyl collectible 3D figure. It uses the same two-stage workflow as the [Figure API](/api/creative-lab-figure). `prototype` (6 credits) generates a styled concept image, and `build` (30 credits) turns it into a textured 3D model with GLB and OBJ + MTL outputs. See [Pricing](/api/pricing) for the full breakdown.

### `Jul 13`

- Added a new **Smart Topology** `model_type` to the [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d) API, offering two models through `ai_model`: `meshy-t1` (the current low-poly model) and `meshy-t2` (a new model with cleaner topology, natively separated parts, triangle output, and a face count you can set with `target_polycount`). `meshy-t2` is the default under `smart-topology`. The existing `model_type: lowpoly` is now deprecated but continues to serve traffic for backward compatibility.

### `Jul 7`

- Added the `aspect_ratio` parameter to the [Image to Image](/api/image-to-image#create-an-image-to-image-task) API, so you can control the output image ratio when editing. Allowed values are `1:1`, `16:9`, `9:16`, `4:3`, `3:4` for the nano-banana models and `1:1`, `3:2`, `2:3` for `gpt-image-2`. Optional; defaults to `1:1`, and cannot be combined with `generate_multi_view`.

## June 2026
### `Jun 17`

- New **[API Playground](/api/playground)** docs page: an interactive console for trying endpoints without writing code, then copying the equivalent cURL, Python, or JavaScript. Available on the Pro, Premium, Ultra, Studio, and Enterprise plans.

### `Jun 15`

- New **[UV Unwrap API](/api/uv-unwrap)**: generate a high-quality UV layout for an existing 3D model (the prerequisite step before texturing, or any time you need a clean, non-overlapping UV layout for downstream tools). Takes either an `input_task_id` (a completed Image to 3D, Text to 3D, or Remesh task) or a `model_url` (`.glb` only) and returns a "UV white model" with brand-new UV coordinates. 5 credits per call. Supports meshes of up to 40,000 faces (run [Remesh](/api/remesh) first if larger); quad and n-gon meshes are triangulated during UV generation.

### `Jun 12`

- Updated **Creative Lab API** Build pricing to **30 credits** per call for [Keychain](/api/creative-lab-keychain), [Fridge Magnet](/api/creative-lab-fridge-magnet), and [Figure](/api/creative-lab-figure) (previously 20). [Lamp](/api/creative-lab-lamp) is unchanged at 30 credits. Prototype pricing is unchanged at 6 credits per image. See [Pricing](/api/pricing) for the full breakdown.

### `Jun 5`

- Added the optional `alpha_thumbnail` parameter to the [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d), [Multi-Image to 3D](/api/multi-image-to-3d), [Text to 3D](/api/text-to-3d), [Retexture](/api/retexture), [Remesh](/api/remesh), and [Repair Printability](/api/repair-printability) APIs. When set to `true`, the task additionally renders a transparent-background (RGBA) version of the preview and returns it under the new `alpha_thumbnail_url` response field. The existing `thumbnail_url` is unchanged. Defaults to `false`.

### `Jun 1`

- New **Creative Lab APIs**: a family of product-scoped endpoints that turn a source photo (or text prompt) into a 3D-printable consumer product. Four products at launch: [Keychain](/api/creative-lab-keychain), [Fridge Magnet](/api/creative-lab-fridge-magnet), [Figure](/api/creative-lab-figure), and [Lamp](/api/creative-lab-lamp). Each follows a two-stage `prototype` → `build` workflow chained through `input_task_id`, served under product-scoped URLs (`/openapi/creative-lab/<product>/v1/...`) with per-product versioning so products can evolve on independent version lines. Prototype: 6 credits per call. Build: 30 credits per call.

## May 2026
### `May 26`

- Added `multi_view_thumbnails` parameter to the [Multi-Image to 3D](/api/multi-image-to-3d) API. When set to `true`, the task additionally renders four cardinal-view thumbnails (front, right, back, left) and returns them under the new `thumbnail_urls` response field. The existing `thumbnail_url` field is unchanged. Adds approximately 3 seconds to task latency.

### `May 22`

- The convert and resize functionality from the [Remesh API](/api/remesh) is now available as standalone [Convert API](/api/convert) and [Resize API](/api/resize) endpoints. The deprecated parameters on Remesh will continue to work for backward compatibility.

### `May 13`

- Added `multi_view_thumbnails` parameter to the [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d) API. When set to `true`, the task additionally renders four cardinal-view thumbnails (front, right, back, left) and returns them under the new `thumbnail_urls` response field. The existing `thumbnail_url` field is unchanged. Adds approximately 3 seconds to task latency.

### `May 12`

- Added `resize_longest_side` parameter to the [Remesh](/api/remesh) API. Resizes the model so the longest bounding-box dimension equals the specified value in meters. Mutually exclusive with `resize_height` and `auto_size`.

### `May 11`

- Deprecated `symmetry_mode` parameter on [Text to 3D](/api/text-to-3d), [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d), and [Multi-Image to 3D](/api/multi-image-to-3d) endpoints. This parameter no longer affects output.

### `May 7`

- New [Analyze Printability API](/api/analyze-printability): Analyze a succeeded Meshy task, or any 3D model URL, for FDM 3D printing readiness. Async create + stream pattern: POST returns a task_id, then GET / SSE stream return watertightness, volume, hole, and non-manifold-edge metrics when SUCCEEDED. Free, no credits consumed.
- New [Repair Printability API](/api/repair-printability): Repair a 3D model for FDM printability, fixing non-manifold edges, degenerate faces, holes, and other topology issues. Accepts an existing Meshy `input_task_id` or a `model_url` (`.glb`, `.stl`, `.obj`). Output format matches the input. 10 credits per task.

## April 2026
### `Apr 27`

- Added `consumed_credits` field to all task responses across every API endpoint. Shows the number of credits consumed by each task. The field is present for tasks in `PENDING`, `IN_PROGRESS`, and `SUCCEEDED` statuses. Returns `0` for `FAILED` tasks (credits are automatically refunded on failure). See [Pricing](/api/pricing) for credit costs per endpoint.

### `Apr 24`

- Added `model_url` parameter to the [Multi-Color Print](/api/multi-color-print#create-a-multi-color-3d-print-task) endpoint. Submit a textured 3D model directly (with a URL or Data URI) instead of an `input_task_id` from a prior Meshy task. Supported formats: `.glb`, `.fbx`. When both `model_url` and `input_task_id` are provided, `input_task_id` takes priority.

### `Apr 21`

- Added `input_task_id` parameter to the [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d#create-an-image-to-3d-task) and [Multi-Image to 3D](/api/multi-image-to-3d#create-a-multi-image-to-3d-task) endpoints. Reference a completed Text to Image or Image to Image task's output directly instead of providing `image_url` / `image_urls`. When both are supplied, `input_task_id` takes priority.

### `Apr 20`

- Added `hd_texture` parameter to the [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d#create-an-image-to-3d-task), [Multi-Image to 3D](/api/multi-image-to-3d#create-a-multi-image-to-3d-task), [Text to 3D Refine](/api/text-to-3d#create-a-text-to-3d-refine-task), and [Retexture](/api/retexture#create-a-retexture-task) endpoints. When enabled, the base color texture is generated at 4K (4096×4096) resolution for higher detail. Only supported for `meshy-6` and `latest`. Defaults to `false`.
- The PBR bundle returned when `enable_pbr` is `true` now includes an `emission` map under `texture_urls` for `meshy-6` and `latest` tasks across [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d), [Multi-Image to 3D](/api/multi-image-to-3d), [Text to 3D Refine](/api/text-to-3d#create-a-text-to-3d-refine-task), and [Retexture](/api/retexture). No request change is required.

### `Apr 14`

- Added `decimation_mode` parameter to the [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d#create-an-image-to-3d-task), [Multi-Image to 3D](/api/multi-image-to-3d#create-a-multi-image-to-3d-task), [Text to 3D Preview](/api/text-to-3d#create-a-text-to-3d-preview-task), and [Remesh](/api/remesh#create-a-remesh-task) endpoints. Sets the adaptive decimation polycount level: `1` (ultra), `2` (high), `3` (medium), or `4` (low).

### `Apr 12`

- Restructured API documentation: added parameter grouping with dependent fields, inline defaults, required/deprecated badges, expandable sub-navigation, and split Multi-Image, Rigging, and Animation into separate pages.

## March 2026
### `Apr 2`

- Added `3mf` format support to `target_formats` parameter across all endpoints ([Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d), [Text to 3D](/api/text-to-3d), [Remesh](/api/remesh), [Retexture](/api/retexture)). Note: 3MF is opt-in only and must be explicitly requested.
- New [Multi-Color Print API](/api/multi-color-print): Convert 3D models to multi-color 3MF format for 3D printing. Supports 1 to 16 color palettes with configurable precision. 10 credits per task.

### `Mar 20`

- Retired the Meshy-4 AI model. All API requests using `meshy-4` are no longer supported. Migrate to `meshy-6` or `latest`.
- Added `auto_size` and `origin_at` parameters to the [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d#create-an-image-to-3d-task), [Multi-Image to 3D](/api/multi-image-to-3d#create-a-multi-image-to-3d-task), [Text to 3D](/api/text-to-3d), and [Remesh](/api/remesh#create-a-remesh-task) endpoints. When `auto_size` is enabled, the service uses AI vision to estimate real-world height and resize the model automatically. `origin_at` sets the origin position (`bottom` or `center`). In the Remesh API, `auto_size` is mutually exclusive with `resize_height`.

### `Mar 17`

- Added optional `target_formats` parameter to [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d#create-an-image-to-3d-task), [Multi-Image to 3D](/api/multi-image-to-3d#create-a-multi-image-to-3d-task), [Text to 3D](/api/text-to-3d), and [Retexture](/api/retexture#create-a-retexture-task) endpoints. Specify which 3D formats to generate (for example, `["glb", "fbx"]`) to reduce task completion time.

## February 2026
### `Feb 28`

- Added `remove_lighting` parameter to the [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d#create-an-image-to-3d-task), [Multi-Image to 3D](/api/multi-image-to-3d#create-a-multi-image-to-3d-task), [Text to 3D Refine](/api/text-to-3d#create-a-text-to-3d-refine-task), and [Retexture](/api/retexture#create-a-retexture-task) APIs. Removes highlights and shadows from the base color texture for cleaner results under custom lighting. Only supported for `meshy-6` and `latest`. Defaults to `true`.
- The [Retexture](/api/retexture#create-a-retexture-task) and [Text to 3D Refine](/api/text-to-3d#create-a-text-to-3d-refine-task) APIs now support `meshy-6` as an `ai_model` value for full Meshy 6 texturing.

### `Feb 25`

- Added `image_enhancement` parameter to the [Image to 3D](/api/image-to-3d#create-an-image-to-3d-task) and [Multi-Image to 3D](/api/multi-image-to-3d#create-a-multi-image-to-3d-task) APIs for users who want to opt out of input image optimization and preserve the exact appearance of their input. Only supported for `meshy-6` and `latest`. Defaults to `true`.

### `Feb 20`

- Added `model_type` parameter to the [Text to 3D Preview](/api/text-to-3d#create-a-text-to-3d-preview-task) API for generating low-poly meshes optimized for cleaner polygons.

# Text to 3D API
Source: https://docs.meshy.ai/api/text-to-3d

# Text to 3D API

Generate 3D models from text prompts in your own application.

Text to 3D works in two steps. First, create a **preview** task (`mode: "preview"`) to generate a 3D mesh without texture, so you can check the shape. Then, send the successful preview's task ID to a **refine** task (`mode: "refine"`) to texture the mesh. Both steps use the same endpoint.

---

## POST /openapi/v2/text-to-3d -- Create a Text to 3D preview task

Creates a Text to 3D preview task, which generates an untextured 3D mesh (geometry only) from a text prompt. This is the first step of the two-step workflow. After the preview succeeds, send its task ID in a refine task to texture the mesh. See [Create a Text to 3D refine task](#create-a-text-to-3d-refine-task). For the full response schema, see [The Text to 3D task object](#the-text-to-3d-task-object).

The task runs in the background. For how long a task usually takes, see [Processing times](/api/task-lifecycle#processing-times).

### Parameters

  - `mode` · *string* · **required**

  The step of the two-step workflow. Send `preview` to create a preview task.

  - `prompt` · *string* · **required**

  Text that describes the object to generate, up to 800 characters. Longer text returns `400`.

  - `model_type` · *string* · default: `standard`

  The type of 3D mesh to generate.

  Available values:
  * `standard`: a high-detail 3D mesh
  * `smart-topology`: a Smart Topology mesh. Choose the model with `ai_model` (`meshy-t2` or `meshy-t2.5`).

  With `smart-topology`, Meshy ignores `should_remesh` and `decimation_mode`, and accepts only `topology: triangle`.

  - `ai_model` · *string* · default: `latest`

  The AI model that generates the 3D model. The available values depend on `model_type`.

  Standard models (`model_type: standard`):
  * `meshy-6-lite`
  * `meshy-6`
  * `meshy-7.1`
  * `latest`: Meshy 7.1
  * `meshy-7` (deprecated): send `meshy-7.1` instead

  Smart Topology models (`model_type: smart-topology`):
  * `meshy-t2`: cleaner topology, natively separated parts, triangle output, and a face count you set with `target_polycount`
  * `meshy-t2.5` (default): sharper detail for game assets, triangle output, and a face count you set with `target_polycount`

  - `geometry_resolution` · *string* · default: `standard`

  The geometry generation pass. Applies only to preview tasks. A refine with this parameter returns `400`.

  Available values:
  * `standard`
  * `2k`: runs the Ultra pass at 2048³
  * `4k`: runs the Ultra pass at 4096³, for finer surface detail

  `2k` needs `meshy-7.1`, `latest`, or the deprecated `meshy-7`. `4k` needs `meshy-7.1` or `latest`. Other models return `400`.

  - `ultra_mode` · *boolean* · default: `false` · **deprecated**

  Send `geometry_resolution` instead. `ultra_mode: true` is the same as `geometry_resolution: "2k"`.

  - `should_remesh` · *boolean* · default: `true (meshy-6-lite), false (other models)`

  Whether to remesh the model after generation. For the highest-quality 3D model, send `false`.

**Only when `should_remesh` is set:**
  - `topology` · *string* · default: `triangle`

  The face type of the remeshed model.

  Available values:
  * `quad`: a quad-dominant mesh
  * `triangle`: a decimated triangle mesh

  Smart Topology output is triangle-only. Sending `quad` with `ai_model` `meshy-t2` or `meshy-t2.5` returns `400`.

  - `decimation_mode` · *integer*

  Adaptive face count, by level. When you set it, Meshy ignores `target_polycount`.

  Available values:
  * `1`: ultra
  * `2`: high
  * `3`: medium
  * `4`: low

  - `target_polycount` · *integer*

  The number of faces to aim for. The result can differ from the target, depending on the geometry. It applies in two separate cases:
  * **Remesh**: with `should_remesh: true` on a `standard` model. Meshy remeshes (decimates) the mesh to about this count. If you set `decimation_mode`, Meshy uses it and ignores `target_polycount`.
  * **Smart Topology**: with `model_type: smart-topology` and `ai_model` `meshy-t2` or `meshy-t2.5`. Meshy generates the model at this face count directly. No remesh runs, and you don't need `should_remesh`.

  The following table shows the range and default for each case:

  | Case | Range | Default |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | Remesh | `100` to `300000` | `30000` |
  | `meshy-t2` | `100` to `15000` | `4000` |
  | `meshy-t2.5` | `100` to `30000` | `15000` |

  A value outside the range returns `400`.

  - `symmetry_mode` · *string* · default: `auto` · **deprecated**

  Leave it out. This parameter doesn't affect the output.

  Available values:
  * `off`: disables symmetry
  * `auto`: applies symmetry based on the input geometry
  * `on`: enforces symmetry during generation

  - `pose_mode` · *string* · default: `""`

  The pose of the generated model.

  Available values:
  * `a-pose`: an A pose
  * `t-pose`: a T pose
  * `""` (empty string): no specific pose

  - `is_a_t_pose` · *boolean* · default: `false` · **deprecated**

  Send `pose_mode` instead. Whether to generate the model in an A pose or a T pose.

  - `art_style` · *string* · default: `realistic` · **deprecated**

  Leave it out. Meshy ignores it.

  - `moderation` · *boolean* · default: `false`

  Whether to screen `prompt` for harmful content before generating. If Meshy detects harmful content, the request returns `400` and Meshy doesn't create a task.

  - `target_formats` · *string[]*

  The file formats to generate. Meshy generates and returns only these formats, which can shorten the task. If you leave it out, Meshy generates every format except `3mf`, which it generates only when you request it.

  Available values:
  * `glb`
  * `obj`
  * `fbx`
  * `stl`
  * `usdz`
  * `3mf`

  - `alpha_thumbnail` · *boolean* · default: `false`

  Whether to also render a preview with a transparent background (RGBA), returned in `alpha_thumbnail_url` when you get the task. `thumbnail_url` doesn't change.

  - `auto_size` · *boolean* · default: `false`

  Whether to estimate the object's real-world height with AI vision and resize the model to it. Meshy puts the origin at the bottom unless you set `origin_at`.

**Only when `auto_size` is set:**
  - `origin_at` · *string* · default: `bottom`

  Where to put the model's origin, `bottom` or `center`.

### Returns

The `result` field of the response holds the ID of the new Text to 3D task.

### Failure modes

  - `400 - Bad Request`

  The request can't run. The error message says which problem it found. For example:
  * **Missing parameter**: A required parameter, such as `prompt` or `mode`, is missing.
  * **Prompt too long**: `prompt` is over the character limit.
  * **Unsupported model for Ultra**: `geometry_resolution` is `2k` or `4k`, with an `ai_model` that can't run it.

  Fix the request, then send it again. See [Errors](/api/errors#request-errors).

  - `401 - Unauthorized`

  The API key is missing or invalid. Check the `Authorization` header.

  - `402 - Payment Required`

  For example:
  * **Insufficient credits**: The account doesn't have enough credits for this task, or the account reached a credit limit. Check your credit balance, then retry.
  * **Free plan**: Creating a task requires a paid plan. Upgrade your plan in your [subscription settings](https://www.meshy.ai/settings/subscription), then retry.

  - `429 - Too Many Requests`

  You exceeded your rate limit. Wait, then retry. See [Rate limits](/api/rate-limits).

  **cURL**

  ```bash
  # Simple preview with required params only
  curl https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{
    "mode": "preview",
    "prompt": "a monster mask"
  }'

  # Preview with Ultra 4K geometry, remesh, and A-pose
  curl https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{
    "mode": "preview",
    "prompt": "a futuristic robot warrior",
    "ai_model": "meshy-7.1",
    "geometry_resolution": "4k",
    "should_remesh": true,
    "target_polycount": 100000,
    "pose_mode": "a-pose",
    "target_formats": ["glb"]
  }'
  ```

  ```javascript
  import axios from 'axios'

  const headers = { Authorization: `Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}` };

  // Simple preview with required params only
  const payload = {
    mode: 'preview',
    prompt: 'a monster mask',
  };

  try {
    const response = await axios.post(
      'https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d',
      payload,
      { headers }
    );
    console.log(response.data);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
  }

  // Preview with Ultra 4K geometry, remesh, and A-pose
  const advancedPayload = {
    mode: 'preview',
    prompt: 'a futuristic robot warrior',
    ai_model: 'meshy-7.1',
    geometry_resolution: '4k',
    should_remesh: true,
    target_polycount: 100000,
    pose_mode: 'a-pose',
    target_formats: ['glb'],
  };

  try {
    const response = await axios.post(
      'https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d',
      advancedPayload,
      { headers }
    );
    console.log(response.data);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
  }
  ```

  ```python
  import requests

  headers = {
    "Authorization": f"Bearer {YOUR_API_KEY}"
  }

  # Simple preview with required params only
  payload = {
    "mode": "preview",
    "prompt": "a monster mask",
  }

  response = requests.post(
    "https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d",
    headers=headers,
    json=payload,
  )
  response.raise_for_status()
  print(response.json())

  # Preview with Ultra 4K geometry, remesh, and A-pose
  advanced_payload = {
    "mode": "preview",
    "prompt": "a futuristic robot warrior",
    "ai_model": "meshy-7.1",
    "geometry_resolution": "4k",
    "should_remesh": True,
    "target_polycount": 100000,
    "pose_mode": "a-pose",
    "target_formats": ["glb"],
  }

  response = requests.post(
    "https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d",
    headers=headers,
    json=advanced_payload,
  )
  response.raise_for_status()
  print(response.json())
  ```

**Response**

```json
{
  "result": "018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578"
}
```

## POST /openapi/v2/text-to-3d -- Create a Text to 3D refine task

Creates a Text to 3D refine task, which textures the mesh of a completed preview task. Send the ID of a successful preview task as `preview_task_id`. See [Create a Text to 3D preview task](#create-a-text-to-3d-preview-task). This is the second step of the two-step workflow.

The task runs in the background. For how long a task usually takes, see [Processing times](/api/task-lifecycle#processing-times).

### Parameters

  - `mode` · *string* · **required**

  The step of the two-step workflow. Send `refine` to create a refine task.

  - `preview_task_id` · *string* · **required**

  The ID of the preview task to texture. The preview task must have the status `SUCCEEDED`.

  - `enable_pbr` · *boolean* · default: `false`

  Whether to also generate PBR maps (metallic, roughness, and normal) with the base color.

  With `ai_model` `meshy-6`, Meshy also generates an emission map, except at `texture_resolution: 8k`. `meshy-6-lite`, `meshy-7`, `meshy-7.1`, and `latest` don't generate an emission map. Neither does a refine of a `meshy-t2` or `meshy-t2.5` preview that doesn't set `ai_model`.

  - `texture_resolution` · *string* · default: `2k`

  The resolution of the base color texture. Applies only to refine tasks. A preview with this parameter returns `400`.

  Available values:
  * `2k`: 2048×2048
  * `4k`: 4096×4096
  * `8k`: 8192×8192

  Higher resolutions capture more surface detail. `4k` and `8k` need `ai_model` `meshy-6`, `meshy-7.1`, or `latest`. At `8k`, Meshy doesn't generate an emission map.

  - `hd_texture` · *boolean* · default: `false` · **deprecated**

  Send `texture_resolution` instead. `hd_texture: true` is the same as `texture_resolution: "4k"`. If you send both, Meshy uses `texture_resolution`.

  - `texture_prompt` · *string*

  Text that guides the texturing, up to 800 characters. Longer text returns `400`. Send `texture_prompt` or `texture_image_url`, not both. If you send both, Meshy uses `texture_prompt`.

  - `texture_image_url` · *string*

  A 2D image that guides the texturing, as a public URL or a base64-encoded data URI, such as `data:image/jpeg;base64,<your base64-encoded image data>`.

  The image must be a `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.png`, or `.webp` file of at most 20 MB.

  > **Note:** Texturing from an image might not work well when the shape in the image differs a lot from the model.

  - `ai_model` · *string* · default: `inherited from the preview task`

  The AI model that textures the mesh.

  Available values:
  * `meshy-6-lite`
  * `meshy-6`
  * `meshy-7.1`
  * `latest`: Meshy 7.1
  * `meshy-7` (deprecated): send `meshy-7.1` instead

  Leave it out to use the preview task's model, so the preview and its refine run on the same model end to end. Send a value to override it. An explicit `latest` resolves the same way as on the preview task, so a `latest` preview and its `latest` refine always use the same texture model.

  - `moderation` · *boolean* · default: `false`

  Whether to screen `texture_prompt` and `texture_image_url` for harmful content before generating. If Meshy detects harmful content, the request returns `400` and Meshy doesn't create a task.

  - `remove_lighting` · *boolean* · default: `true`

  Whether to remove highlights and shadows from the base color texture. The cleaner result works better under custom lighting.

  Takes effect only when `ai_model` is `meshy-6`. `meshy-7.1` and `latest` accept it and ignore it, and so does a refine of a `meshy-t2` or `meshy-t2.5` preview that doesn't set `ai_model`. Sending it with `meshy-6-lite` returns `400`.

  - `target_formats` · *string[]*

  The file formats to generate. Meshy generates and returns only these formats, which can shorten the task. If you leave it out, Meshy generates every format except `3mf`, which it generates only when you request it.

  Available values:
  * `glb`
  * `obj`
  * `fbx`
  * `stl`
  * `usdz`
  * `3mf`

  - `alpha_thumbnail` · *boolean* · default: `false`

  Whether to also render a preview with a transparent background (RGBA), returned in `alpha_thumbnail_url` when you get the task. `thumbnail_url` doesn't change.

  - `auto_size` · *boolean* · default: `false`

  Whether to estimate the object's real-world height with AI vision and resize the model to it. Meshy puts the origin at the bottom unless you set `origin_at`.

**Only when `auto_size` is set:**
  - `origin_at` · *string* · default: `bottom`

  Where to put the model's origin, `bottom` or `center`.

### Returns

The `result` field of the response holds the ID of the new Text to 3D task.

### Failure modes

  - `400 - Bad Request`

  The request can't run. The error message says which problem it found. For example:
  * **Invalid task ID**: `preview_task_id` is invalid, or doesn't match one of your preview tasks.
  * **Task not ready**: The preview task hasn't succeeded yet.
  * **Model mismatch**: The preview task's AI model doesn't work with the requested refine model.
  * **Unsupported model for remove_lighting**: `remove_lighting` was sent with `ai_model: "meshy-6-lite"`.

  Fix the request, then send it again. See [Errors](/api/errors#request-errors).

  - `401 - Unauthorized`

  The API key is missing or invalid. Check the `Authorization` header.

  - `402 - Payment Required`

  For example:
  * **Insufficient credits**: The account doesn't have enough credits for this task, or the account reached a credit limit. Check your credit balance, then retry.
  * **Free plan**: Creating a task requires a paid plan. Upgrade your plan in your [subscription settings](https://www.meshy.ai/settings/subscription), then retry.

  - `429 - Too Many Requests`

  You exceeded your rate limit. Wait, then retry. See [Rate limits](/api/rate-limits).

  **cURL**

  ```bash
  # Basic refine task
  curl https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{
    "mode": "refine",
    "preview_task_id": "018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578",
    "enable_pbr": true
  }'

  # Refine with auto-size and GLB format
  curl https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{
    "mode": "refine",
    "preview_task_id": "018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578",
    "target_formats": ["glb"],
    "auto_size": true
  }'
  ```

  ```javascript
  import axios from 'axios'

  const headers = { Authorization: `Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}` };

  // Basic refine task
  const payload = {
    mode: 'refine',
    preview_task_id: '018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578',
    enable_pbr: true,
  };

  try {
    const response = await axios.post(
      'https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d',
      payload,
      { headers }
    );
    console.log(response.data);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
  }

  // Refine with auto-size and GLB format
  const advancedPayload = {
    mode: 'refine',
    preview_task_id: '018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578',
    target_formats: ['glb'],
    auto_size: true,
  };

  try {
    const response = await axios.post(
      'https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d',
      advancedPayload,
      { headers }
    );
    console.log(response.data);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
  }
  ```

  ```python
  import requests

  headers = {
    "Authorization": f"Bearer {YOUR_API_KEY}"
  }

  # Basic refine task
  payload = {
    "mode": "refine",
    "preview_task_id": "018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578",
    "enable_pbr": True,
  }

  response = requests.post(
    "https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d",
    headers=headers,
    json=payload,
  )
  response.raise_for_status()
  print(response.json())

  # Refine with auto-size and GLB format
  advanced_payload = {
    "mode": "refine",
    "preview_task_id": "018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578",
    "target_formats": ["glb"],
    "auto_size": True,
  }

  response = requests.post(
    "https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d",
    headers=headers,
    json=advanced_payload,
  )
  response.raise_for_status()
  print(response.json())
  ```

## DELETE /openapi/v2/text-to-3d/:id -- Delete a Text to 3D task

Permanently deletes a Text to 3D task, including its models and data. You can't undo a delete.

### Path parameters

  - `id` · *path*

  The ID of the task to delete.

### Task status
Deleting a `PENDING` task refunds the credits it used when you created it.

An `IN_PROGRESS` task can't be deleted. The request returns `409 Conflict`,
and the task keeps running. Meshy doesn't refund a task that has started,
so deleting it would cost you both the credits and the result. Wait for it
to reach `SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED`, or `CANCELED`, then delete it.

Deleting a task in a final status (`SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED`, or `CANCELED`)
doesn't refund its credits.

### Returns
`200 OK` when the task is deleted, or `409 Conflict` when the task is
`IN_PROGRESS`.

  **cURL**

  ```bash
  curl --request DELETE \
    --url https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578 \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}"
  ```

  ```javascript
  import axios from 'axios'

  const taskId = '018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578'
  const headers = { Authorization: `Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}` }

  try {
    await axios.delete(
      `https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d/${taskId}`,
      { headers }
    )
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error)
  }
  ```

  ```python
  import requests

  task_id = "018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578"
  headers = {
      "Authorization": f"Bearer {YOUR_API_KEY}"
  }

  response = requests.delete(
      f"https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d/{task_id}",
      headers=headers,
  )
  response.raise_for_status()
  ```

**Response**

```json
// 200 OK on success, with an empty body.
//
// 409 Conflict when the task is IN_PROGRESS. The task keeps running:
{
  "message": "Task is IN_PROGRESS and cannot be deleted. Credits for a task the worker has already started are not refundable; wait for it to reach SUCCEEDED, FAILED or CANCELED, then delete it."
}
```

## GET /openapi/v2/text-to-3d/:id/stream -- Stream a Text to 3D task

Streams a Text to 3D task's updates as Server-Sent Events (SSE).

### Parameters

  - `id` · *path*

  The task ID from the create response.

### Returns

A stream of [Text to 3D task objects](#the-text-to-3d-task-object) as Server-Sent Events.

Each event holds the full task object, in the same shape the Get endpoint returns. While the task is `PENDING` or `IN_PROGRESS`, its result fields don't have values yet.

  **cURL**

  ```bash
  curl -N https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/stream \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}"
  ```

  ```javascript
  const response = await fetch(
    'https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/stream',
    {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}` }
    }
  );

  const reader = response.body.getReader();
  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
  let buffer = '';

  while (true) {
    const { done, value } = await reader.read();
    if (done) break;

    buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
    const lines = buffer.split('\n');
    buffer = lines.pop();

    for (const line of lines) {
      if (line.startsWith('data:')) {
        const data = JSON.parse(line.slice(5));
        console.log(data);

        if (['SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELED'].includes(data.status)) {
          reader.cancel();
        }
      }
    }
  }
  ```

  ```python
  import requests
  import json

  headers = {
      "Authorization": f"Bearer {YOUR_API_KEY}",
      "Accept": "text/event-stream"
  }

  response = requests.get(
      'https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/stream',
      headers=headers,
      stream=True
  )

  for line in response.iter_lines():
      if line:
          if line.startswith(b'data:'):
              data = json.loads(line.decode('utf-8')[5:])
              print(data)

              if data['status'] in ['SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELED']:
                  break

  response.close()
  ```

## The Text to 3D task object
A Text to 3D task object describes one task that generates a 3D model from a **text** prompt. It holds the status, the progress, and the model files when the task succeeds. Text to 3D has two stages, `preview` and `refine`. A preview task generates a mesh-only 3D model, and a refine task generates a textured 3D model from the preview's result.

### Properties

- `id` · *string*

  The task ID. Treat it as an opaque string, and don't rely on its format.

- `type` · *string*

  The task type, `text-to-3d-preview` for a preview task or `text-to-3d-refine` for a refine task.

- `model_urls` · *object*

  Download URLs for the generated 3D model, one per file format. A format the task didn't generate has no key, rather than an empty string.

  - `glb` · *string*

  The GLB file.

  - `fbx` · *string*

  The FBX file.

  - `usdz` · *string*

  The USDZ file.

  - `obj` · *string*

  The OBJ file.

  - `mtl` · *string*

  The MTL file.

  - `stl` · *string*

  The STL file.

  - `3mf` · *string*

  The 3MF file. Present only when `target_formats` includes `3mf`.

- `prompt` · *string*

  The `prompt` you sent to create the task, unmodified.

- `texture_prompt` · *string*

  The text prompt you sent to guide the texturing in the refine stage.

- `ultra_mode` · *boolean* · **deprecated**

  Read `geometry_resolution` instead.

- `geometry_resolution` · *string*

  The Ultra tier the preview task ran, `2k` or `4k`. The field is absent for `standard`.

- `texture_image_url` · *string*

  Download URL for the image you sent to guide the texturing.

- `thumbnail_url` · *string*

  Download URL for a thumbnail image of the 3D model.

- `alpha_thumbnail_url` · *string*

  Download URL for a version of `thumbnail_url` with a transparent background (RGBA). Present only when you created the task with `alpha_thumbnail: true` and Meshy rendered the transparent preview.

- `video_url` · *string* · **deprecated**

  Don't rely on this field, because a future release removes it. Download URL for the preview video.

- `progress` · *integer*

  How much of the task is done, as a percentage. It's `0` until the task starts and `100` when it succeeds.

- `started_at` · *timestamp*

  Time the task started, in Unix milliseconds. It's `0` until the task starts.

- `created_at` · *timestamp*

  Time the task was created, in Unix milliseconds.

- `finished_at` · *timestamp*

  Time the task finished, in Unix milliseconds. It's `0` until the task finishes.

- `status` · *string*

  The task status, one of `PENDING`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED`, or `CANCELED`.

- `texture_urls` · *array*

  Download URLs for the generated texture maps, as an array of objects. It usually holds **one** object. Each object has these fields:

  - `base_color` · *string*

  The base color map.

  - `metallic` · *string*

  The metallic map. Absent when you created the task with `enable_pbr: false`.

  - `normal` · *string*

  The normal map. Absent when you created the task with `enable_pbr: false`.

  - `roughness` · *string*

  The roughness map. Absent when you created the task with `enable_pbr: false`.

  - `emission` · *string*

  The emission map. Absent in any of these cases:
  * You created the task with `enable_pbr: false`.
  * `ai_model` is `meshy-6-lite`, `meshy-7`, `meshy-7.1`, or `latest`.
  * `texture_resolution` is `8k`.
  * The task refines a `meshy-t2` or `meshy-t2.5` preview without setting `ai_model`.

- `preceding_tasks` · *integer*

  The number of tasks ahead of this one in the queue. The value is meaningful only while the task is `PENDING`.

- `task_error` · *object*

  The error details when the task fails. See [Errors](/api/errors#task-errors).

- `consumed_credits` · *integer*

  The number of credits the task used. Present when the status is `PENDING`, `IN_PROGRESS`, or `SUCCEEDED`. It's `0` for a `FAILED` task, because Meshy refunds the credits when a task fails.

<span id="example-text-to-3d-task-object" />

**Example Text to 3D Task Object**

# Image to 3D API
Source: https://docs.meshy.ai/api/image-to-3d

# Image to 3D API

Turn an image into a 3D model, textured or untextured, in the formats you choose. Send the image, or use the output of a Text to Image or Image to Image task.

---

## POST /openapi/v1/image-to-3d -- Create an Image to 3D task

Creates an Image to 3D task. The task runs in the background. For how long a task usually takes, see [Processing times](/api/task-lifecycle#processing-times).

### Parameters

  - `input_task_id` · *string* · **required**

  Required unless you send `image_url`. The ID of a Text to Image or Image to Image task whose image you want to use as the input. The task must be one you created with the API, have the status `SUCCEEDED`, and have produced exactly one image.

  - `image_url` · *string* · **required**

  Required unless you send `input_task_id`. The image to turn into a 3D model, as a public URL or a base64-encoded data URI, such as `data:image/jpeg;base64,<your base64-encoded image data>`. If you send both, Meshy uses `input_task_id`.

  The image must be a JPG, JPEG, PNG, or WebP file of at most 20 MB.

  - `model_type` · *string* · default: `standard`

  The kind of 3D mesh to generate.

  Available values:
  * `standard`: a high-detail mesh
  * `smart-topology`: a mesh from a Smart Topology model, which you pick with `ai_model` (`meshy-t2` or `meshy-t2.5`)

  With `smart-topology`, Meshy ignores `should_remesh`, `save_pre_remeshed_model`, and `decimation_mode`, and accepts only `topology: triangle`.

  - `ai_model` · *string* · default: `latest`

  The AI model that generates the 3D model. The available values depend on `model_type`.

  Standard models (`model_type: standard`):
  * `latest`: Meshy 7.1
  * `meshy-7.1`
  * `meshy-6`
  * `meshy-6-lite`
  * `meshy-7` (deprecated): use `meshy-7.1` instead

  Smart Topology models (`model_type: smart-topology`) produce triangles, at a face count you can set with `target_polycount`:
  * `meshy-t2`: cleaner topology and natively separated parts
  * `meshy-t2.5` (default): sharper detail for game assets

  - `geometry_resolution` · *string* · default: `standard`

  The geometry generation pass.

  Available values:
  * `standard`
  * `2k`: runs the Ultra pass at 2048³
  * `4k`: runs the Ultra pass at 4096³, for the most surface detail

  `2k` needs `meshy-7.1`, `latest`, or the deprecated `meshy-7`. `4k` needs `meshy-7.1` or `latest`.

  - `ultra_mode` · *boolean* · default: `false` · **deprecated**

  Use `geometry_resolution` instead. `ultra_mode: true` is the same as `geometry_resolution: "2k"`.

  - `should_texture` · *boolean* · default: `true`

  Whether to generate textures. `true` returns a textured model, and `false` skips texturing and returns an untextured mesh.

**Only when `should_texture` is set:**
  - `enable_pbr` · *boolean* · default: `false`

  Whether to also generate PBR maps (metallic, roughness, and normal) besides the base color. `true` needs `should_texture: true`, and returns `400` with `should_texture: false`.

  With `meshy-6`, Meshy also generates an emission map, except at `texture_resolution: 8k`. These models don't produce an emission map:
  * `meshy-6-lite`
  * `meshy-7`
  * `meshy-7.1`
  * `meshy-t2`
  * `meshy-t2.5`
  * `latest`

  - `texture_resolution` · *string* · default: `2k`

  The size of the base color texture. A larger texture captures more surface detail.

  Available values:
  * `2k`: 2048×2048
  * `4k`: 4096×4096
  * `8k`: 8192×8192

  `4k` and `8k` aren't available with `meshy-6-lite`, and return `400` with it. At `8k`, Meshy doesn't produce an emission map.

  - `hd_texture` · *boolean* · default: `false` · **deprecated**

  Use `texture_resolution` instead. `hd_texture: true` is the same as `texture_resolution: "4k"`. If you send both, Meshy uses `texture_resolution`.

  - `texture_prompt` · *string*

  Text that guides the texture, up to 800 characters. Longer text returns `400`.

  - `texture_image_url` · *string*

  An image that guides the texture, as a public URL or a base64-encoded data URI, such as `data:image/jpeg;base64,<your base64-encoded image data>`. The image must be a JPG, JPEG, PNG, or WebP file of at most 20 MB.

  Meshy guides the texture with only one of `texture_prompt` and `texture_image_url`. If you send both, Meshy uses `texture_prompt`. For the credit cost of texturing, see [Pricing](/api/pricing).

  > **Note:** Texturing from an image might not work well when the image's shape differs a lot from the 3D model's geometry.

  - `should_remesh` · *boolean* · default: `true (meshy-6-lite), false (other models)`

  Whether to run the remesh phase. For the highest-quality 3D model, set it to `false`.

**Only when `should_remesh` is set:**
  - `topology` · *string* · default: `triangle`

  The face type of the remeshed model.

  Available values:
  * `quad`: a quad-dominant mesh
  * `triangle`: a decimated triangle mesh

  Smart Topology output is triangle-only, so `quad` with `meshy-t2` or `meshy-t2.5` returns `400`.

  - `decimation_mode` · *integer*

  Adaptive face count, by level. When you set it, Meshy ignores `target_polycount`.

  Available values:
  * `1`: ultra
  * `2`: high
  * `3`: medium
  * `4`: low

  - `save_pre_remeshed_model` · *boolean* · default: `false`

  Whether to also store a GLB of the model from before the remesh phase. Meshy returns it in `model_urls.pre_remeshed_glb`.

  - `target_polycount` · *integer*

  The number of faces to aim for. The result can differ from the target, depending on the model's geometry.

  It applies in two separate cases:
  * **Remesh**: When `should_remesh` is `true` on a `standard` model, Meshy decimates the mesh to about this count. If you set `decimation_mode`, Meshy uses it and ignores `target_polycount`.
  * **Smart Topology**: When `model_type` is `smart-topology` and `ai_model` is `meshy-t2` or `meshy-t2.5`, Meshy generates the model at this face count. No remesh runs, and you don't need `should_remesh`.

  The range and default depend on the case:

  | Case | Range | Default |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | Remesh | `100` to `300000` | `30000` |
  | `meshy-t2` | `100` to `15000` | `4000` |
  | `meshy-t2.5` | `100` to `30000` | `15000` |

  A value outside the range returns `400`.

  - `symmetry_mode` · *string* · default: `auto` · **deprecated**

  Leave it out, because it doesn't affect the output. Its values controlled symmetry during generation:
  * `off`: no symmetry
  * `auto`: symmetry chosen from the input geometry
  * `on`: enforced symmetry

  - `pose_mode` · *string* · default: `""`

  The pose for the generated model.

  Available values:
  * `a-pose`: an A pose
  * `t-pose`: a T pose
  * `""` (empty string): no specific pose

  - `is_a_t_pose` · *boolean* · default: `false` · **deprecated**

  Use `pose_mode` instead. Whether to generate the model in an A or T pose.

  - `surface_mode` · *string* · **deprecated**

  Use `ai_model` instead. It doesn't affect the output, because the model generation it selected is retired.

  Accepted values are `organic` and `hard`. Any other value returns `400`.

  - `image_enhancement` · *boolean* · default: `true`

  Whether to optimize the input image before generating. `false` keeps the exact look of the input image, with no style processing.

  It works only with `meshy-6`, `meshy-7.1`, or `latest`. With `meshy-6-lite` or `model_type: smart-topology`, it returns `400`.

  - `remove_lighting` · *boolean* · default: `true`

  Whether to remove highlights and shadows from the base color texture. The result is cleaner and works better under your own lighting.

  It takes effect only with `meshy-6`. `meshy-7.1` and `latest` accept it and ignore it. With `meshy-6-lite` or `model_type: smart-topology`, it returns `400`.

  - `moderation` · *boolean* · default: `false`

  Whether to screen these inputs for harmful content before generating:
  * `image_url`
  * `texture_image_url`
  * `texture_prompt`

  If Meshy detects harmful content, the request returns `400` and Meshy doesn't create a task.

  - `target_formats` · *string[]*

  The file formats to generate. Meshy generates and returns only the formats you list, which can shorten the task. If you leave it out, Meshy generates every format except `3mf`, which you get only when you list it.

  Available values:
  * `glb`
  * `obj`
  * `fbx`
  * `stl`
  * `usdz`
  * `3mf`

  - `auto_size` · *boolean* · default: `false`

  Whether to estimate the object's real-world height with AI vision and resize the model to it. Meshy puts the origin at the bottom unless you set `origin_at`.

  - `alpha_thumbnail` · *boolean* · default: `false`

  Whether to also render a preview with a transparent background (RGBA), returned in `alpha_thumbnail_url` when you get the task. `thumbnail_url` doesn't change.

  - `multi_view_thumbnails` · *boolean* · default: `false`

  Whether to also render front, right, back, and left previews, returned in `thumbnail_urls` when you get the task. `thumbnail_url` doesn't change and still shows the front view. This adds about 5 seconds to the task.

**Only when `auto_size` is set:**
  - `origin_at` · *string* · default: `bottom`

  Where to put the model's origin, `bottom` or `center`.

### Returns

The `result` field of the response holds the ID of the new Image to 3D task.

### Failure modes

  - `400 - Bad Request`

  The request can't run. The error message says which problem it found. For example:
  * **Missing parameter**: Neither `image_url` nor `input_task_id` was sent.
  * **Invalid input task**: `input_task_id` isn't a `SUCCEEDED` Text to Image or Image to Image task that produced exactly one image.
  * **Invalid image format**: The `image_url` image isn't a JPG, JPEG, PNG, or WebP file.
  * **Unreachable URL**: Meshy can't download the `image_url` image, because the URL returns `404` or times out.
  * **Image too large**: The `image_url` or `texture_image_url` image is over 20 MB.
  * **Invalid data URI**: The base64 string is malformed.
  * **Invalid parameter combination**: `enable_pbr` is `true`, and `should_texture` is `false`.
  * **Unsupported model for Ultra**: `geometry_resolution` is `2k` or `4k`, with an `ai_model` that can't run it.
  * **Unsupported model for image options**: `image_enhancement` or `remove_lighting` was sent with `ai_model: "meshy-6-lite"` or `model_type: "smart-topology"`.

  Fix the request, then send it again. See [Errors](/api/errors#request-errors).

  - `401 - Unauthorized`

  The API key is missing or invalid. Check the `Authorization` header.

  - `402 - Payment Required`

  For example:
  * **Insufficient credits**: The account doesn't have enough credits for this task, or the account reached a credit limit. Check your credit balance, then retry.
  * **Free plan**: Creating a task requires a paid plan. Upgrade your plan in your [subscription settings](https://www.meshy.ai/settings/subscription), then retry.

  - `404 - Not Found`

  `input_task_id` doesn't match any of your tasks. Check the task ID, then send the request again.

  - `429 - Too Many Requests`

  You exceeded your rate limit. Wait, then retry. See [Rate limits](/api/rate-limits).

**cURL**

```bash
# Simple request with required params
curl https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v1/image-to-3d \
  -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "image_url": "<your publicly accessible image url or base64-encoded data URI>"
  }'

# With Ultra 4K geometry, remesh, PBR, and A-pose
curl https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v1/image-to-3d \
  -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "image_url": "<your publicly accessible image url or base64-encoded data URI>",
    "ai_model": "meshy-7.1",
    "geometry_resolution": "4k",
    "enable_pbr": true,
    "should_remesh": true,
    "target_polycount": 100000,
    "should_texture": true,
    "pose_mode": "a-pose",
    "target_formats": ["glb"]
  }'
```

```javascript
import axios from 'axios'

const headers = { Authorization: `Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}` };

// Simple request with required params
const payload = {
  image_url: "<your publicly accessible image url or base64-encoded data URI>",
};

try {
  const response = await axios.post(
    'https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v1/image-to-3d',
    payload,
    { headers }
  );
  console.log(response.data);
} catch (error) {
  console.error(error);
}

// With Ultra 4K geometry, remesh, PBR, and A-pose
const advancedPayload = {
  image_url: "<your publicly accessible image url or base64-encoded data URI>",
  ai_model: "meshy-7.1",
  geometry_resolution: "4k",
  enable_pbr: true,
  should_remesh: true,
  target_polycount: 100000,
  should_texture: true,
  pose_mode: "a-pose",
  target_formats: ["glb"],
};

try {
  const response = await axios.post(
    'https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v1/image-to-3d',
    advancedPayload,
    { headers }
  );
  console.log(response.data);
} catch (error) {
  console.error(error);
}
```

```python
import requests

headers = {
    "Authorization": f"Bearer {YOUR_API_KEY}"
}

# Simple request with required params
payload = {
    "image_url": "<your publicly accessible image url or base64-encoded data URI>",
}

response = requests.post(
    "https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v1/image-to-3d",
    headers=headers,
    json=payload,
)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json())

# With Ultra 4K geometry, remesh, PBR, and A-pose
advanced_payload = {
    "image_url": "<your publicly accessible image url or base64-encoded data URI>",
    "ai_model": "meshy-7.1",
    "geometry_resolution": "4k",
    "enable_pbr": True,
    "should_remesh": True,
    "target_polycount": 100000,
    "should_texture": True,
    "pose_mode": "a-pose",
    "target_formats": ["glb"],
}

response = requests.post(
    "https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v1/image-to-3d",
    headers=headers,
    json=advanced_payload,
)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json())
```

## DELETE /openapi/v1/image-to-3d/:id -- Delete an Image to 3D task

Permanently deletes an Image to 3D task, including its models and data. You can't undo a delete.

### Path parameters

  - `id` · *path*

  The ID of the task to delete.

### Task status

Deleting a `PENDING` task refunds the credits it used when you created it.

An `IN_PROGRESS` task can't be deleted. The request returns `409 Conflict`,
and the task keeps running. Meshy doesn't refund a task that has started,
so deleting it would cost you both the credits and the result. Wait for it
to reach `SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED`, or `CANCELED`, then delete it.

Deleting a task in a final status (`SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED`, or `CANCELED`)
doesn't refund its credits.

### Returns

`200 OK` when the task is deleted, or `409 Conflict` when the task is
`IN_PROGRESS`.

  **cURL**

  ```bash
  curl --request DELETE \
    --url https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v1/image-to-3d/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578 \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}"
  ```

  ```javascript
  import axios from 'axios'

  const taskId = '018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578'
  const headers = { Authorization: `Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}` }

  try {
    await axios.delete(
      `https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v1/image-to-3d/${taskId}`,
      { headers }
    )
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error)
  }
  ```

  ```python
  import requests

  task_id = "018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578"
  headers = {
      "Authorization": f"Bearer {YOUR_API_KEY}"
  }

  response = requests.delete(
      f"https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v1/image-to-3d/{task_id}",
      headers=headers,
  )
  response.raise_for_status()
  ```

**Response**

```json
// 200 OK on success, with an empty body.
//
// 409 Conflict when the task is IN_PROGRESS. The task keeps running:
{
  "message": "Task is IN_PROGRESS and cannot be deleted. Credits for a task the worker has already started are not refundable; wait for it to reach SUCCEEDED, FAILED or CANCELED, then delete it."
}
```
